item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera feels feverish at home in Pune, so her mother uses a digital clinical thermometer to check her body temperature.
Which action gives a safe and correct temperature reading?

options.A: placing the tip under Meera's tongue and reading the number as soon as it appears
options.B: placing the tip under Meera's tongue while she keeps her mouth open during the reading
options.C: washing only the metal tip before use and reading it after the beep
options.D: washing the tip before and after use, placing it under Meera's tongue with her mouth closed, and reading it after the beep
